title: ray-tracing-shapely-optiland: 3D verification of ray-tracing-shapely designs in Optiland
description: 3D verification of ray-tracing-shapely nonimaging-optics designs through Optiland's non-sequential ray tracer: a 2D design's profile revolved or extruded into a 3D scene, traced, and compared with the 2D result, with notebook-embedded visualisation and ray and run persistence.
